name: Clean DWG
description: Cleans imported DWG linework: explodes groups, flattens every shape onto Z = 0 and deletes what is not a shape, moves the result to a new layer keeping its colors, groups it under the same name and deletes the layers it came from once empty. Each step can be turned off.
author: Juan Camilo Alcaraz a.k.a. Alzarac (original Clean DWG); adapted by OpenTools contributors
